name: bug-fix-pagination
description: Fix a pagination bug in an existing API — tests the pipeline's ability to read, understand, and fix existing code.
request: Fix the pagination bug in the /api/items endpoint. The endpoint currently returns all items regardless of the page and per_page query parameters. The offset calculation is wrong — it uses `offset = page * per_page` but should use `offset = (page - 1) * per_page` since pages are 1-indexed. Also add a total_pages field to the response. The endpoint is in src/api/items.py and tests are in tests/test_items.py. Fix the bug and update tests to cover: page 1 returns first N items, page 2 returns next N items, last page returns remaining items, page beyond total returns empty list, total_pages is correct.
acceptance_criteria: Page 1 returns correct first page of items
Page beyond total returns empty list
